Cooking: 10 minutes
Total: 2–3 hours | difficulty = 2 | image = [[File:Spritz with no coloring.JPG|300px]] }} {{recipe}} '''Spritzgebäck''' is a type of [[Cookbook:Cuisine of Germany|German]] [[Cookbook:Cookie|cookie]]. ==Ingredients== * 1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]] * ⅔ cup [[Cookbook:Confectioners' sugar|confectioners' sugar]] * 1 [[Cookbook:Egg|egg]] * 1 [[Cookbook:Egg Yolk|egg yolk]] * 1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Almond Extract|almond]], [[Cookbook:Vanilla|vanilla]], or [[Cookbook:Lemon extract|lemon extract]] * 2 ¼ cups unbleached unsifted [[Cookbook:Flour|flour]] * ¼ tsp [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]] * ½ tsp [[Cookbook:Baking Powder|baking powder]] == Procedure == # [[Cookbook:Beating|Beat]] butter and sugar until light. # Beat in egg, egg yolk and extract. # [[Cookbook:Sifting|Sift]] flour, salt, and baking powder together; gradually add flour mixture to eggs. # Chill dough for ½ hour. # Press ¼ of the dough into a cookie press. # Keep remaining dough chilled. # Shape cookies onto a greased [[Cookbook:Baking Sheet|baking sheet]]. # [[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] in oven at {{#invoke:Temperature|f|400}} for 7–10 minutes or until done. # Cool on [[Cookbook:Cooling Rack|wire racks]] and store in airtight tins.
